description: List filers with official identity (congressional filers carry their Bioguide ID; executive-branch filers return null with an explanation — identifiers are never invented). Filter by bioguide, by the exact member_id a disclosure row carries, or by a substring of the name as filed. Resolve a person with name first, then confirm with the returned member_id or bioguide.

member_id.description: Exact filer identifier from a disclosure row, e.g. nancy-pelosi

name.description: Case-insensitive substring of the filer's full name, e.g. pelosi

name: list_members

chamber.description: House, Senate or executive-branch filer class from the directory; null when unavailable.

coverage.description: Existing directory coverage semantics retained. In the paginated response, read at coverage.served_at in the same statement as identity.

average_filing_delay_days.description: Directory aggregate of transaction-to-filing days, rounded by the existing SQL view; null without measured intervals. Not a timeliness verdict.

disclosures_available.description: Rows counted by the existing directory's candidate-view aggregate for this member, not a separately pinned API-version count.

filings_pending_qualification.description: Nonnegative difference between directory total held rows and candidate aggregate rows; not a per-reason exclusion census.

filings_pending_receipt.description: Pending-receipt rows reported by the directory's latest member coverage observation, or its executive-branch receipt predicate; not distinct document count.

latest_filed_date.description: Maximum filing date among this member's directory candidate rows; null without one.

district.description: House district as `STATE-N`, 0 for an at-large seat; null for senators and executive-branch filers. The same form every disclosure row's member.district uses.

full_name.description: Name carried by the existing directory; null when unavailable.

identity.description: Directory identity join, independent of financial disclosure counts.

bioguide.description: Mapped official congressional Bioguide ID, or null when unmapped or inapplicable.

note.description: Explanation of a missing identity mapping; null when an identifier is present.

system.description: Identifier namespace, not a statement that every filer has an identifier in it.

member_id.description: Filer identifier from the directory; the ascending key for opt-in pagination.

party.description: Directory party label, or null without a mapping.

state.description: Directory state code, or null when unavailable or inapplicable.

directory.description: Which relation answered and how old it is. Present on every directory response so a reader never has to assume the age of what they were served.

fallback_reason.description: Why the live view answered, or null when the snapshot did. Published rather than hidden: a directory served from an unexpected source is a fact about this response.

max_age_seconds.description: The age past which the snapshot is refused and the live view answers instead. A bound this response was checked against, not a service commitment.

refreshed_at.description: When the snapshot rows in this response were copied from the view. Null when the live view answered, because a live read has no refresh instant to report.

source.description: Which relation answered. `snapshot` is the four-hourly copy of the directory view; `live_view` is the view itself, used whenever the snapshot cannot be trusted. Both carry identical rows by construction: the snapshot has no predicate of its own.
